UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user account profile and metadata stored privately per user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document owner.

email.description: Primary email address of the user.

connectedMethods.description: Connected authentication providers such as google or password.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
